text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While walking in front of the station, I saw a flyer on the bulletin board announcing an amusement park event.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh! "Limited Event: Zombie Revelry"?
A desperate game of hide-and-seek with zombies at an amusement park...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, Trainer!
So, are you interested in this kind of stuff too?
choice_data_list: Looked like a good way to get some exercise.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, same here!
Wonder if Helios and the gang would be into it? Let me send a pic...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? A LANE message just came in... wait, WHAT?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Helios is in the nurse's office, for real?!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: Yeah, she apparently got all dizzy in the library...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
That sounds bad... Thanks for telling me!
I'll go check on her!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if she has a fever...
Maybe she could eat some jelly?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Cold medicine, cooling gel sheets... and...
Ah, some sports drinks would be good too!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
My favorite person ever is way too perfect~~!
Palmerrr! Thank youuu!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, thank goodness. You're actually pretty full of energy!
Feeling a lot better than you thought?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Doing assignments totally fried my brain, y'know.
Like, a wisdom fever or somethin'! Totally that!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, wasn't that LANE message
super crazy cut off? What was that about?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Ah—nah. I was walking while typing,
so I just kind of lost my train of thought.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, look,
you really should get some proper rest—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Big fat liaaaar, nanoda~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Windy?! Doto, too...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, actually, we spotted you near the station...
and you seemed so frantic and in a rush,
so we got really worried...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
And when we followed you, what gives, Palmer!
Just say it honestly, nanoda!
"I wanna go to the amusement park event with you!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh?! What, you were watching?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
What's this about an event, whaaat~~?!
Like, obviously we're totally joining in!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: No... but aren't you not feeling well?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Obviously I'm gonna get better instantly!!
Palmer, you gotta speak up about what you wanna do way moreee!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! A minion of the Demon King Army
should just snatch whatever they want, nanoda!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
M-Me too! If there's anything I can do,
I'll do absolutely anything to help~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Everyone...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...If you're gonna go that far, then I guess I'll say it.
Are you really sure? What about everyone's health, or plans, and stuff?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
Come on, hurry up, hurry up~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Alright then! With everyone who's here right now!
I would really love to join the amusement park event!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Fooooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: And that means you over there too, Digital!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
!?!?!?!?!
I-I've been exposed... ababababa...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, just as Mejiro Palmer wished,
it was decided that everyone would gather
at the amusement park...
